levelNote: 80 questions — 60 multiple choice and 20 practical against a supplied image — untimed and unproctored, which is why this sits below a proctored forensics exam of the same scope rather than beside one. The practical half is genuine analysis, so the discount is smaller than an unproctored format alone would suggest. The training is the strongest part of the credential and is weighted at tier 2, above the Essentials rating SANS gives FOR500. Gold, Silver and Bronze tiers reflect which attempt you passed on. Does not expire. Exam-only score 50, +7 for the training.
